name: Parcel Drone (Standard)
description: Small autonomous delivery drones that fill the airspace of Tier 2-4 districts like mechanical insects. They carry packages up to 5 kg and navigate by a combination of GPS, visual mapping, and mesh network coordination. In Tier 1 districts, they're rare — the theft rate exceeds 40% and the drones learn to avoid certain blocks entirely. The buzzing of parcel drones is the ambient sound of commerce.
armament: Anti-tamper shock system, GPS tracking, self-destruct on theft (premium models).
common_usage: Package delivery, food delivery, medical supply transport, small-item logistics.
story_hooks: Parcel drones in a specific district have been delivering packages that nobody ordered to addresses that don't exist
Someone figures out how to reprogram parcel drones as surveillance platforms and now the sky is full of corporate spies
